meta.title: Guides
meta.description: Learn how to measure, apply, and care for your press-on nails with our step-by-step guides.

flexibleTape.title: Flexible measuring tape
flexibleTape.step1: At the widest part of your nail bed, place the flexible measuring tape from one edge to the other, following the natural curve of your nail.
flexibleTape.step2: Record your measurement and repeat for each nail.

stickyTape.title: Sticky tape
stickyTape.step1: Paste sticky tape over the widest part of your nail bed, following its natural curve.
stickyTape.step2: Use a pen to mark both edges of the tape at the widest point of your nail bed.
stickyTape.step3: Remove the tape and use a ruler to measure the marked distance.
stickyTape.step4: Record your measurement and repeat for each nail.

I hold five professional certifications: – two in manicure – two in pedicure – one in nail extensions. AboutMe.description2: Kyoute Nails was created to provide accessible, high-quality press-on nail designs for those who want beautiful results quickly and conveniently. My goal is to combine professional standards with modern design, so every client receives a product that looks polished, neat, and uplifting.

meta.title: Shipping
meta.description: Shipping areas, processing times, and delivery costs for Kyoute Nails orders.

areas.title: Shipping Areas
areas.body: We currently ship within Latvia only. We're working on expanding to other Baltic countries soon.

processingTime.title: Processing Time
processingTime.body: Orders are processed within 1-3 business days. Custom press-on sets may take up to 5 business days due to handmade production.

deliveryTime.title: Delivery Time
deliveryTime.body: Once shipped, standard delivery within Latvia takes 1-3 business days via Omniva or DPD parcel lockers.

cost.title: Shipping Cost
cost.body: Shipping costs €3.50 for standard delivery. Free shipping is available on orders over €50.

tracking.title: Order Tracking
tracking.body: You'll receive a tracking number by email once your order ships, so you can follow its journey to your door.

issues.title: Shipping Issues
issues.body: If your order hasn't arrived within the expected timeframe, please contact us and we'll help track it down or arrange a replacement.

meta.title: Refund Policy
meta.description: Return window, eligibility, and refund process for Kyoute Nails orders.

returnWindow.title: Return Window
returnWindow.body: You have 14 days from the date of delivery to request a return, in line with EU consumer protection law.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.body: Items must be unused, unopened, and in their original packaging to qualify for a return. Press-on nails that have been worn or removed from their packaging cannot be returned for hygiene reasons.

customOrders.title: Custom Orders
customOrders.body: Custom press-on nail sets made to your specifications are final sale and cannot be returned unless defective.

howToReturn.title: How to Return
howToReturn.body: Contact us via the contact form with your order number to start a return. We'll provide instructions and a return address.

refundProcess.title: Refund Process
refundProcess.body: Once we receive and inspect your return, we'll process your refund within 5-7 business days to your original payment method.

damagedItems.title: Damaged or Incorrect Items
damagedItems.body: If you received a damaged or incorrect item, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos, and we'll arrange a replacement or full refund at no extra cost.

meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How Kyoute Nails collects, uses, and protects your personal data in accordance with GDPR.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.body: This Privacy Policy explains how Kyoute Nails collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you visit our website or make a purchase, in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

dataCollected.title: Data We Collect
dataCollected.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, shipping address, and order details, as well as data collected automatically through cookies and analytics tools.

howWeUseData.title: How We Use Your Data
howWeUseData.body: We use your data to process orders, communicate with you about your purchases, respond to inquiries, and improve our website and services.

thirdParties.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParties.body: We share data with trusted third parties necessary to operate our store, including Shopify for order processing, payment providers, and shipping carriers. These providers are bound by their own privacy obligations.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience, remember your preferences, and analyze website traffic. You can control cookie settings through your browser.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.body: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, including legal, accounting, or reporting requirements.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.body: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the use of your personal data, and to request a copy of the data we hold about you. Contact us to exercise these rights.

security.title: Data Security
security.body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, please contact us through our contact page.
